input.job_description:
We are hiring a delivery lead for a payments platform. You will own a portfolio of four teams, run quarterly planning, and keep dependencies visible across engineering, risk and operations. Experience with regulated releases, incident reviews and measurable service objectives is essential.

Requirements:
- Own quarterly planning across four delivery teams and make dependencies visible before the commitment date.
- Run release readiness reviews with engineering, risk and operations, and record the decision and its owner.
- Set service objectives with measurable targets for availability, latency and change failure rate.
- Lead incident reviews within five working days and track each action to a named owner and a due date.
- Partner with finance on cloud cost controls and show how each saving was validated.
- Coach two team leads through a full planning cycle and hand over the review agenda when they are ready.
- Manage a risk register with clear triggers, mitigations and escalation paths for regulated releases.
- Improve first-time fix rate and report the trend monthly to operations and customer support.
- Design a rollback drill that the support team can run without the delivery lead present.
- Work with product and design to cut low-value roadmap items and protect the remaining commitments.
- Write short decision notes for non-technical readers, including the options considered and the trade-off.
- Track benefits after a programme milestone and stop work when the evidence no longer supports the case.
